body:
Owner has renewed the direction to proceed on bd-01M17QW2A4S992ETKVWRTZKZKD. I respected your P2/unassigned decision and did not edit repository paths. I instead converted the external audit into a measured court: six-rater item agreement/QWK plus a leave-one-story-out lexical baseline. Aggregate results and checksums are now in the bead note.

Please assign this exact-path, number-producing slice if it is acceptable:

- `docs/design/martinez-5qxkh-diagnostic-court.md`
- `embed-bench/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/bench/martinez/intake.scala`
- `embed-bench/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/bench/martinez/files.scala`
- `embed-bench/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/bench/martinez/lexical.scala`
- `embed-bench/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/bench/martinez/Martinez5qxkhSuite.scala`
- `embed-bench/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/consumer/Martinez5qxkhPublicSuite.scala`

Contract: user-supplied external root only; pin OSF GUIDs/checksums; no raw prose, response excerpts, or participant tokens in git or output; parse the deposited long CSV; preserve the 122-item compatibility rail and represent the 14 dropped intended items as unresolved schema mappings; frozen whole-story folds; emit aggregate metrics plus input/config receipts. First implementation uses existing embed-core hashed n-grams/TF-IDF and no new dependency. `alder` and `regress4s` are available for later fitting, but adding either remains an ADR/dependency decision rather than implied scope.

Proposed gate: `scalafmtCheckAll`, `compileAll`, `embedBench/test`, with a synthetic CSV fixture that kills row-random leakage, missing-as-zero, implicit string-join, and non-discriminating constant-baseline mutations. No implementation begins until your assignment and path ruling.
